name: Nanakase Gizumo
source:
Tatsuki’s pet cat whom he picked up after Kotoko died. Yes, pet cat. Even though she has the appearance of a girl, she still behaves like a cat (e.g. sleeps a lot, says “nya” a lot, goes into heat, ect). She also doesn’t speak much at the start. Some of the other characters are quite cold to her though. Unlike any maids, she is very bad at cooking and cleaning. Gizumo is also very hostile of Yuzu and her antics.

"Mantis, will you eat? Will you not eat? I caught it, do you, hate it?"

On the night of shooting stars she gets her wish to become human ...mostly.
